messages.snippet: Daniel, Sofia, Denham Lewis are at 300% on the liability cap. My recommendation is to counter at 150
messages.subject: Brookmere - cap strategy before the call
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Sofia,

Denham Lewis are at 300% on the liability cap. My recommendation is to counter at 150% of trailing 12-month fees (~£1.35m on Year-1 fees), concede payment terms to 45 days as a goodwill move, hold the 90-day renewal notice, and offer a narrow 'correct material errors on notice' obligation on the dataset as the sole remedy - not an accuracy warranty. I think that lands the deal. Advice note to follow before signature.

Call with Denham Lewis is Thursday. OK to proceed on that basis?

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
